entities.summary: Soviet, a notable figure in the history of Belarus, associated with World Wars & Byelorussian SSR (1939–1945). Preceded by Belarusian People's Republic proclaimed and Revolution, BPR & Soviet Annexation. Their legacy influenced Khatyn massacre (March 22, 1943) — symbol of Nazi atrocities and Liberation of Minsk (July 3, 1944) during Operation Bagration.
